free_tier.stated: Free tier: max upload 5120 Mb, download volume '20 GB in 1 days', files deleted '15 days after last download'. The 'Registered' column gives 10240 Mb, 10240 GB storage, 30 GB/day and 30 days.
free_tier.notes: Registration doubles the per-file cap and adds storage; the anonymous tier has no storage column at all.

per_object_cap.stated: Premium 102400 Mb (100 GB); Registered 10240 Mb (10 GB); Free 5120 Mb (5 GB)

retention.stated: Free 15 days after last download; Registered 30 days; Premium 60 days

egress.terms: Download volume per day: Free '20 GB in 1 days', Registered 30 GB, Premium 60 GB. Premium also lists 'Remote URL upload', accelerator support and resume.

record.interface_detail: Web upload with remote URL upload on premium. No API or FTP published on the page read.
record.tooling: Browser only as read. Not on the Leechall list; it is reachable through a paid debrid or a direct subscription.
record.chaining: 60 GB/day on premium is more than the 34.1 GB/day that 1 TiB a month needs, and 100 GB per file means a single Blu-ray remux fits. For bulk transfer it is the most usable shape of the cheap hosts compared.

limits.value: 60 GB per day of download volume on premium
100 GB per file premium, 10 GB registered, 5 GB free
free files deleted 15 days after the last download

record.limits_note: The storage row reads 'Unlimited' for premium and '10240 GB' for registered; only the free column is blank.
record.binding_note: 60 GB/day is 1.76 TB a month, above the 1 TiB monthly volume, so at this scale nothing in the vocabulary breaks. Volume-quota is named because it is the only counter the vendor states and the first one a larger workload would meet.

identity_cost.detail: Premium at $15 for 30 days; the page shows no payment-method list beyond checkout. Signup is a form with an email.

record.reliability_note: The 15-day free retention is the shortest in tested services, so a free-tier link shared on 2026-10-23 can be dead in two weeks.
record.confidence_note: Prices and the three-column feature table read on the vendor premium page. The free tier's actual speed is unread.

evidence.proved: the five prices (7 days $10, 30 days $15, 90 days $30, 180 days $50, 365 days $90) and the three-column table: 5/10/100 GB upload cap, 20/30/60 GB per day, 15/30/60 day retention
26.9 M+ files shared, 2000 Tb+ total disk used, 129 K+ active members

record.notes: The $90 year is $7.50 a month. The 7-day plan at $10 is the only short trial in tested services and is the cheapest way to test whether a specific host's speed holds.
